{{libheader|big_integer}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">#include "big_int/big_integer.bi"

Dim Shared As BigInt zero, one, two
zero = 0: one = 1: two = 2

Function isOddBigInt(Byref valor As BigInt) As Boolean
    Return ((valor Mod two) = 1)
End Function

Function BitLenBigInt(Byref a As BigInt) As Integer
    If a <= zero Then Return 0
    
    Dim As BigInt log2a = zero
    Dim As BigInt tmp = a
    Dim As Integer bits = 0
    
    While tmp > zero
        tmp Shr= 1
        bits += 1
    Wend
    
    Return bits
End Function

' Exponentiation function (x^y mod m)
Function ExpBigInt(Byref x As BigInt, Byref y As BigInt, Byref m As BigInt) As BigInt
    Dim As BigInt result = 1
    Dim As BigInt x_mod_m = x Mod m
    Dim As BigInt y_copy = y
    
    If m = one Then Return zero
    
    While y_copy > zero
        If isOddBigInt(y_copy) Then result = (result * x_mod_m) Mod m
        y_copy Shr= 1
        x_mod_m = (x_mod_m * x_mod_m) Mod m
    Wend
    
    Return result
End Function

' Montgomery object type
Type Montgomery
    m As BigInt     ' Modulus; must be odd
    n As Integer    ' m.bitLen()
    r As BigInt     ' R = 2^n
    rrm As BigInt   ' R^2 mod m
End Type

Function initMontgomery(Byref m As BigInt) As Montgomery
    Dim As Montgomery result
    
    ' Check that m is positive and odd
    Dim As Boolean isPositive = (m > zero)
    Dim As Boolean isOdd = isOddBigInt(m)
    
    If (Not isPositive) Or (Not isOdd) Then
        Print "Error: modulus must be positive and odd"
        Sleep: End
    End If
    
    result.m = m
    result.n = BitLenBigInt(m)
    
    ' R = 2^n
    Dim As BigInt r = one
    For i As Integer = 1 To result.n
        r *= two
    Next
    result.r = r
    
    Dim As BigInt shift_amount = one
    For i As Integer = 1 To 2 * result.n
        shift_amount *= two
    Next
    result.rrm = shift_amount Mod m
    
    Return result
End Function

Function Reduce(Byref mont As Montgomery, Byref t As BigInt) As BigInt
    Dim As BigInt result = t
    
    For i As Integer = 0 To mont.n - 1
        If (result Mod two) = one Then result += mont.m
        
        result Shr= 1
    Next
    
    If result >= mont.m Then result -= mont.m
    
    Return result
End Function

Function BigIntToStr(Byref n As BigInt) As String
    If n = 0 Then Return "0"
    
    Dim As String result
    Dim As BigInt tmp = n
    Dim As BigInt ten = 10
    Dim As BigInt digit
    
    While tmp <> 0
        digit = tmp Mod ten
        result = Chr(Cint(digit) + Asc("0")) & result
        tmp \= ten
    Wend
    
    Return result
End Function

' Main program
Sub main()
    Const base2 = 2
    
    ' Create big integers
    Dim As BigInt m, x1, x2
    m = "750791094644726559640638407699"
    x1 = "540019781128412936473322405310"
    x2 = "515692107665463680305819378593"
    
    ' Initialize Montgomery object
    Dim As Montgomery mont = initMontgomery(m)
    
    ' Calculate Montgomery representations
    Dim As BigInt t1 = x1 * mont.rrm
    Dim As BigInt t2 = x2 * mont.rrm
    
    ' Reduce
    Dim As BigInt r1 = Reduce(mont, t1)
    Dim As BigInt r2 = Reduce(mont, t2)
    
    ' Calculate r = 1 << n
    Dim As BigInt r = 1
    For i As Integer = 1 To mont.n
        r *= two
    Next
    
    ' Print results
    Print "b : "; base2
    Print "n : "; mont.n
    Print "r :  "; BigIntToStr(r)
    Print "m :  "; BigIntToStr(m)
    Print "t1:  "; BigIntToStr(t1)
    Print "t2:  "; BigIntToStr(t2)
    Print "r1:  "; BigIntToStr(r1)
    Print "r2:  "; BigIntToStr(r2)
    
    Print !"\nOriginal x1       : "; BigIntToStr(x1)
    Print "Recovered from r1 : "; BigIntToStr(Reduce(mont, r1))
    Print "Original x2       : "; BigIntToStr(x2)
    Print "Recovered from r2 : "; BigIntToStr(Reduce(mont, r2))
    
    Print !"\nMontgomery computation of x1^x2 mod m:"
    
    ' Calculate x1^x2 mod m using Montgomery multiplication
    Dim As BigInt prod = Reduce(mont, mont.rrm)
    Dim As BigInt basenum = Reduce(mont, x1 * mont.rrm)
    Dim As BigInt e = x2
    
    While e > zero
        If isOddBigInt(e) Then prod = Reduce(mont, prod * basenum)
        
        e Shr= 1
        basenum = Reduce(mont, basenum * basenum)
    Wend
    
    Dim As BigInt finalResult = Reduce(mont, prod)
    Print BigIntToStr(finalResult)
    
    Print !"\nAlternate computation of x1^x2 mod m:"
    Dim As BigInt altResult = ExpBigInt(x1, x2, m)
    Print BigIntToStr(altResult)   
End Sub

main()

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
